description: Manage DingTalk products via CLI: AI Tables, Attendance, Calendar, Group Chats & Bots, Contacts, Open Platform Docs, DING messages, DingTalk Docs, Drive, AI Minutes, Mail, OA Approvals, Reports, and To-Dos.

display.description_en: Manage DingTalk products via CLI: AI Tables, Attendance, Calendar, Group Chats & Bots, Contacts, Open Platform Docs, DING messages, DingTalk Docs, Drive, AI Minutes, Mail, OA Approvals, Reports, and To-Dos.
display.description_zh: 通过命令行管理钉钉全产品能力：AI 表格、考勤、日历、群聊与机器人、通讯录、开放平台文档、DING 消息、钉钉文档、钉钉云盘、AI 听记、邮箱、OA 审批、日志、待办。
examples_en: Send a bot notification to the DingTalk group 'Product Weekly': weekly meeting at 15:00 in Room 3F, please bring last week's progress materials
Show my DingTalk schedule for next week, list meetings related to 'client sync' (time, attendees, room), and find a slot when all three of us are free for a sync
Add a row to the DingTalk AI Table 'Task Tracker': title=Q2 Launch Review, owner=Zhang San, due=2026-05-20, status=In Progress
Use KQL to search my DingTalk Mail for emails from the finance team in the past week with 'reimbursement' in the subject; list sender, date, and summary
Turn today's AI Minutes 'Product Review' into notes (summary + action items + key speakers), then submit it as a Daily Report in DingTalk Reports and @ my direct manager
examples_zh: 在钉钉群【产品周会】里用机器人发一条通知：今天 15:00 在 3 楼会议室开周会，记得带上周的进展材料
查一下我下周的钉钉日程，列出和【客户对接】相关的会议（时间、参会人、会议室），并帮我找出三人都空闲的时段约一次同步会
在钉钉 AI 表格【任务跟踪】里新增一行：标题=Q2 上线评审、负责人=张三、截止时间=2026-05-20、状态=进行中
用 KQL 搜索我钉钉邮箱里最近一周来自财务部、主题包含【报销】的邮件，列出发件人、日期和摘要
把今天的 AI 听记【产品评审会】整理成纪要（摘要 + 待办 + 关键发言人），并按【日报】模版提交到钉钉日志 @ 我的直属领导
